headline: SBI Cards Q2 profit rises 75% on lower bad loan provisions
hook: Profit surges despite shrinking credit growth
summary: SBI Cards reported a net profit of Rs 778 crore for Q2 FY27, a 75% increase compared to the same period last year. The growth was primarily supported by a reduction in credit costs and improved asset quality metrics. However, the company faced headwinds as corporate card spending fell and net interest margins tightened. Receivables also contracted during the quarter, reflecting a slowdown in overall credit expansion.
why_it_matters: Lower credit costs boost earnings despite slowing consumer and corporate spending.
winners_losers: SBI Cards gains / Corporate card segment hurt

headline: SBI Cards And Payment Services files credit rating information with the exchange
hook: Routine credit rating update from SBI Card
summary: SBI Cards And Payment Services Limited has submitted a credit rating disclosure to the stock exchanges. The filing follows standard regulatory disclosure norms for listed financial entities. Retail investors can review the official exchange filing for detailed rating specifics.
why_it_matters: Procedural credit rating filing with no immediate impact on stock price.

headline: SBI Cards reports 75% jump in Q2 profit to Rs 778 crore, beating estimates.
hook: Sharp drop in bad loans drives surge
summary: SBI Cards and Payment Services reported a 75% rise in net profit to Rs 778 crore for the second quarter, driven by a sharp decline in impairment losses compared to the previous year. Revenue from operations grew 3% during the quarter. The profit figure exceeded analysts' estimates. Lower bad loan provisions directly boosted the card issuer's bottom line.
whats_next: Management earnings conference call and analyst updates
why_it_matters: Better asset quality lifts profitability for credit card holders.
winners_losers: SBI Card shareholders gain / bad loan provisions hurt less

headline: SBI Cards reports Q2 FY27 financial results
summary: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited has formally submitted its financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. Retail investors and cardholders can review the detailed earnings report to gauge credit growth, default rates, and profitability. These results reflect the current spending trends in the urban and semi-urban Indian consumer credit market. Monitoring these metrics helps assess the health of India's unsecured lending segment.
whats_next: Management earnings call and analyst discussions on asset quality.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings shape near-term sentiment for credit card investors.

headline: Infosys, Tata Motors, and 73 other companies to announce Q2 results today
hook: Major quarterly earnings blitz underway today
summary: A total of 75 companies are scheduled to announce their second-quarter results today. Prominent market names reporting earnings include Infosys, Tata Motors, Adani Power, BPCL, and SBI Card. The announcements span key sectors such as information technology, automobiles, energy, and financial services. Individual stock volatility is expected throughout the trading day as these financial performance reports are filed.
whats_next: Q2 earnings filings to be released during trading hours today.
why_it_matters: Earnings results will drive stock movements in IT, auto, and banking.

headline: Domestic institutional investors raise stakes in eight midcap stocks in Q2 FY27
hook: Institutional buying shifts to select midcaps
summary: Domestic institutional investors increased their shareholding by over 200 basis points across eight prominent midcap and largecap-adjacent stocks during the September 2026 quarter. The companies receiving higher institutional allocation include Swiggy, One97 Communications, Meesho, Cochin Shipyard, Lenskart Solutions, Piramal Finance, APL Apollo Tubes, and SBI Cards and Payment Services, according to StockEdge data. This accumulation reflects growing institutional confidence in these specific businesses despite broader market volatility. Retail investors tracking institutional money flows can use these holdings to gauge which midcaps are attracting professional capital.
why_it_matters: Institutional accumulation validates midcap fundamental strength for retail portfolios
winners_losers: Listed midcaps gain / uncommitted retail sidelined

headline: SBI Card launches Eternal co-branded credit card offering discounts on Zomato and Blinkit
hook: New co-branded card targets quick-commerce spending
summary: SBI Card has introduced the Eternal credit card in partnership with Eternal platforms, offering up to 10 percent discounts across Zomato, Blinkit, and District. The card aims to capture high-frequency spending in food delivery and quick-commerce sectors. Retail investors in SBI Card and consumer internet platforms can monitor user adoption rates. The partnership strengthens customer stickiness for food delivery and quick-commerce services.
whats_next: Quarterly metrics on card adoption and spending volumes
why_it_matters: Higher card adoption could boost spending volumes on Zomato and Blinkit.
winners_losers: Zomato and SBI Card gain / competitors hurt

headline: SBI Card launches Eternal credit card with Zomato Gold and cashback
hook: New festive card packs lifestyle perks
summary: SBI Card has launched a new credit card named Eternal, targeted at festive shoppers, diners, and moviegoers. The card bundles Zomato Gold membership with various cashback benefits for everyday purchases and leisure activities. Retail consumers looking for rewards on dining and entertainment are the primary target audience. Indian retail investors should note new product rollouts as an indicator of festive spending trends and consumer financing growth.
why_it_matters: Festive product launches could drive spending volumes for SBI Card.
winners_losers: SBI Card gains / rival issuers challenged

headline: SBI Cards launches Eternal SBI Card cashback product on October 15, 2026
hook: New premium reward card enters the market
summary: SBI Cards and Payment Services has announced the launch of a new cashback product named the Eternal SBI Card, scheduled for release on October 15, 2026. The new offering aims to capture a larger share of the competitive digital payments and credit card rewards segment. SBI Cards is one of the leading credit card issuers in the country, and new product rollouts directly influence its fee income and customer acquisition metrics. For Indian retail investors, portfolio performance in the financial sector depends on SBI Cards' ability to sustain transaction volumes and customer growth against rising competition.
why_it_matters: New product launch could impact future card issuance and revenue growth.
winners_losers: SBI Cards gains / rival card issuers hurt

summary: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges about a new product launch. The company filed the regulatory disclosure pursuant to listing regulations. hook: New cobranded plastic hits the market
summary: SBI Cards and Payment Services has announced the launch of a new cobranded credit card in partnership with Eternal. The press release detailing the collaboration was submitted to the stock exchanges on October 15, 2026. Such partnerships typically aim to expand customer acquisition through shared merchant ecosystems. Retail investors can track how cobranded launches influence the company's card issuance numbers and fee income.

headline: Motilal Oswal, SBI, Quant and others top ELSS mutual fund return charts over 3 and 5 years
hook: Long-term winners revealed across top ELSS funds
summary: ET Now has published performance rankings for Equity Linked Savings Schemes (ELSS), highlighting the top-performing tax-saving mutual funds over three-year and five-year horizons. The data compares returns from major fund houses including Motilal Oswal, SBI Mutual Fund, and Quant Mutual Fund. ELSS funds offer tax deductions under Section 80C alongside equity growth potential, subject to a mandatory three-year lock-in period. Retail investors evaluating tax-saving investment avenues can use these performance charts to compare historical fund returns against peers.
why_it_matters: Compare historical returns before picking tax-saving equity funds.

headline: Delhi Consumer Commission orders SBI Cards to refund Rs 15,000 for unauthorised transactions
hook: Consumer panel rules against SBI Cards
summary: The Delhi Consumer Commission has held SBI Cards liable for unauthorised transactions on a customer's account and ordered a refund of Rs 15,000. This ruling highlights the legal responsibility of credit card issuers in securing accounts against fraudulent activity. Such consumer forum judgments set precedents for grievance redressal in the banking sector. Indian credit card holders dealing with disputed transactions can reference this ruling for claims.
why_it_matters: Strengthens cardholder rights in unauthorised transaction disputes.
winners_losers: Credit card holders gain / SBI Cards hurt

headline: Axis Bank becomes first Indian partner for Apple Pay
hook: Apple Pay launches in India via Axis
summary: Apple Pay has officially launched in India, with Axis Bank serving as the initial banking partner. Major lenders including HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and SBI Card are currently absent from the rollout. The delay for larger banks is attributed to complex commercial negotiations and integration hurdles required by Apple. This move marks a significant expansion for Apple's fintech services in the Indian digital payments ecosystem.
why_it_matters: Axis Bank gains a competitive edge in premium digital payment services.
winners_losers: Axis Bank gains / Other major lenders lag
